result.title: Controllable Diverse Sampling through Pullback Directions
result.comment: Accepted at the DynaFront workshop at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Conditional diffusion models can generate high-quality images that align closely with a given prompt. However, samples generated from different random seeds may remain visually similar, limiting creative exploration. Existing approaches can increase variation, but often require additional optimization or sampling overhead, while stronger perturbations may introduce distortions that degrade image quality or prompt alignment. We propose a training-free method that leverages the local pullback geometry induced by the mapping from the conditioning-embedding space to the image space to identify directions of maximal output sensitivity. By steering different sampling trajectories along these directions, we encourage distinct generations while maintaining consistency with the conditioning signal. Experiments on MS-COCO and BrushNet show the efficacy of the method in improving diversity on prompt-conditioned image generation and inpainting.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种免训练方法：利用条件嵌入空间到图像空间映射所诱导的 pullback 几何，找出输出最敏感的方向，沿这些方向引导不同采样轨迹，从而在保持提示一致的同时提升生成多样性，并在 MS-COCO 与 BrushNet 上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用 pullback 几何定位条件嵌入空间中「输出敏感方向」的思路，可能可供核查 latent 推理状态中哪些维度真正承载任务必要视觉信息，但论文属图像生成多样性研究，与 VLM 推理的联系需较多核查。
